description: Output schema for defect prediction agents. Each agent returns an array of failure scenario candidates.

symbol.description: Target function or method name (e.g., 'load_policy' or 'MyClass.method')

scenario.description: One-line description of the failure scenario

category.description: Which prediction angle identified this scenario

trigger_input.description: Concrete input values or state conditions that trigger the failure

expected_behavior.description: What the code should do (correct behavior) when this scenario occurs

priority.description: high = data loss/crash risk, medium = incorrect output, low = suboptimal behavior
